## Best Used-Car Fit for a Melbourne Family

For your budget and driving pattern, **Option A: 2018 Toyota Corolla** is the best value overall. It stays under budget, has the strongest reliability profile, and should deliver the lowest long-term running costs of the three.

## Side-by-Side Value Comparison

| Option | Price | Km | Budget Fit | Reliability Outlook | Fuel Economy | Family Practicality | Risk Flags |
|---|---:|---:|---|---|---|---|---|
| A: 2018 Toyota Corolla | AUD 19,500 | 62,000 | Yes | Excellent | Very good | Good for 4 | None noted |
| B: 2017 Mazda CX-5 | AUD 22,800 | 88,000 | No | Good, but more wear risk | Fair | Best space/comfort | Minor accident reported |
| C: 2019 Hyundai i30 | AUD 20,900 | 54,000 | Yes | Good | Very good | Good for 4 | Two previous owners |

## Ranked Recommendation

### 1) Option A — 2018 Toyota Corolla
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/car-front.svg
- **Best overall value** for reliability, fuel use, and low maintenance.
- **Full service history** is a major plus for long-term confidence.
- Strong fit for **mostly city driving** plus one monthly highway trip.
- Likely the easiest to own cheaply in Melbourne.

### 2) Option C — 2019 Hyundai i30
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/car-front.svg
- Slightly newer and lower km than the Corolla.
- Also fits your budget and should be economical to run.
- **Two previous owners** adds a little more uncertainty than Option A.
- Good second choice if condition and service records are excellent.

### 3) Option B — 2017 Mazda CX-5
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/car-front.svg
- Best if you want more space and a higher driving position.
- But it is **over budget**, has **higher km**, and a **minor accident** on record.
- As a family car, it’s practical, but it will usually cost more to fuel, service, and potentially repair than the hatchbacks.

## What I’d Choose for You

**Pick the Corolla unless the i30 has clearly better condition, tires, brakes, and service history.**

Why:
- **Lowest expected maintenance**
- **Best fuel economy**
- **Strong resale value**
- **Within budget with room left for inspection, transfer, and early servicing**
